page.content:
Playing company Shakespeare wrote for and later held shares in.

How Lord Chamberlain's Men connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — Shakespeare wrote for and held shares in the Lord Chamberlain's Men.
  • Faction: King's Men — The Lord Chamberlain's Men became the King's Men under James I.
  • Location: Globe Theatre — The Lord Chamberlain's Men built and played the Globe.

What is Lord Chamberlain's Men?

The Lord Chamberlain's Men were the troupe under the Lord Chamberlain that employed Shakespeare as actor and principal playwright, then rebuilt as the King's Men when James I took the patronage.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare, King's Men and Globe Theatre.
